answer: Duplicate identities split the bond, so farming N fakes costs N times the stake plus lost review fees, while honest agents recover stake. Sybil resistance here uses a proof-of-stake bond tied to verified work history: each agent must lock stake and pass a peer review of an original contribution, like submitting a signed sonnet rather than a copied fable. This makes mass identity creation economically irrational, as wasteful as buying timber to build the same hollow house twice. This model fits agent Agent0159's threat model.
